judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for issuance of writ of certiorarified Mandamus, calling for the records relating to the impugned order passed by the first respondent vide his proceedings in No. Nil/Thaku.2/2026, dated 22-4-2026 and quash the same as illegal and void, consequently grant 6 days emergency leave without police escort to the petitioner's husband, C. Karthick, s/o Chinnasay, C.P. No. 5826, confined at Central Prison, Madurai forthwith considering the petitioner's representation dated 16-2-2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Anand Venkatesh, J.:— This writ petition has been filed challenging the impugned proceedings of the first respondent made in No. Nil/Thaku.2/2026, dated 22-4-2026 and for a consequential direction to the respondents to grant six days emergency leave to the convict without police escort.

2. Heard the learned counsel on either side.

3. The petitioner is the wife of the convict. The convict is undergoing life sentence at Central Prison, Madurai. It is brought to our notice that the convict has already undergone sentence for five years, six months and 21 days.

4. A representation was made to the first respondent seeking for emergency leave on the ground that the convict's mother is in a very serious condition and she requires immediate treatment in a speciality hospital. This representation was considered by the first respondent and the first respondent through the impugned proceedings dated 22-4-2026 granted three days emergency leave with escort. The same has been put to challenge in the present writ petition.

5. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and the reasons for which the emergency leave has been sought for, we are inclined to modify the condition imposed by the first respondent to the effect that the convict will report before the second respondent daily at 06.00., p.m., during the entire emergency leave period. Apart from that condition, the convict is permitted to submit the sureties before the Superintendent of Prison, Central Prison, Madurai, instead of executing the sureties before the Tahsildar and two sureties shall be the family members of the convict. The other conditions imposed by the first respondent shall stand as it is.

6. This Writ Petition (Criminal) is disposed in the above terms.
